objective: Build a global privacy-first, lower-cost digital ecosystem that grows primarily through product value, referrals, partnerships and owned media before scaling paid acquisition.

positioning.headline: One account. One AI. Everything.
positioning.promise: A simpler, private, lower-cost alternative to fragmented productivity and AI stacks.
differentiators: No behavioural tracking or advertising IDs
Open import/export and low switching friction
Lower total cost than comparable Microsoft/Google stacks
Fair-use access instead of artificial message scarcity where capacity allows

audiences.need: Affordable AI + daily productivity without lock-in or profiling
Email, docs, storage, AI, websites, finance and marketing in one lower-cost stack
Classroom, administration, AI tutoring, collaboration and content
AI, design, audio, video, publishing and audience growth
Code, cloud, data, APIs and AI without fragmented vendors
Private deployable infrastructure, data control, procurement simplicity and localisation

launch_phases.name: Founding 1,000
launch_phases.goal: Acquire 1,000 activated accounts through referrals, existing IZAKHONO audiences and partners before meaningful paid media.

launch_phases.name: Product-Market Proof
launch_phases.goal: Prove activation, retention, referral and cost-per-active-user economics.

launch_phases.name: Scale
launch_phases.goal: Expand partner distribution, business/education licensing and profitable paid acquisition.

pricing_targets.note: Targets only. Final public prices require cost proof and sellable gate.

free.goal: Useful core access and fair-use AI where capacity permits

individual.goal: Global entry subscription below major incumbent business-entry pricing

business_entry.goal: Below US$5/user/month and below comparable entry business suites

creator.goal: Existing approved Creative Suite core price

growth_loops.mechanism: Every activated account receives a personal invite link. Referrals are counted only after the referred account successfully activates/signs in.
Native share/copy/WhatsApp/email actions on public product surfaces.
Every IZAKHONO product can route users into ONE Account and ONE AI without separate identity stacks.
Edu-Build learners/facilitators become a structured adoption channel for ONE Classroom/AI.
Bundle ONE with websites, SUPER ACCOUNTANT, WorkNow, payments and marketing for small businesses.
Creators generate campaign assets in IZAKHONO Studio and distribute through Growth OS.

channels.paid: Approval-gated. Start only after conversion and retention economics are measured.

kpis.activation: account verified + first useful AI/product action
economics: AI inference cost per active account

guardrails: No paid campaign activation without approval
No public price until cost proof supports it
No live claims without independent verification
Referral attribution is one-time account attribution, not cross-site behavioural tracking
